note: Function declarations for the campus walking route planner. The shape is the OpenAPI subset Gemini, Claude and OpenAI all accept; adapt the wrapper key per provider.

functionDeclarations.name: plan_route
functionDeclarations.description: Plan the walking route across the JHU Homewood campus. Returns real geometry from A* over the campus path network, with distance, time and a leg breakdown. The route automatically cuts across open lawns where that is faster and finishes at whichever entrance or car-park lift is nearest, so there is nothing to configure. Always call this rather than describing a route from memory; never write or adjust coordinates yourself. This plans walking routes only and knows nothing about wheelchair access. Repeat every string in the result's `warnings` to the user. A route whose `summary.stepsBesideShortcut` is non-zero must never be described as step-free, however low `summary.steps` is: a shortcut can land on the far side of a flight, and this data holds no elevation.

origin.description: Where the trip starts, as a building or outdoor space name, e.g. 'Malone Hall'. Free text is resolved against the place index.

destination.description: Where the trip ends, e.g. 'San Martin Garage'.

functionDeclarations.name: list_places
functionDeclarations.description: Every routable place name on campus, with its use and any alias. Call this when a name the user gave does not resolve, or when plan_route returns status 'ambiguous'.
